target.title: refactor: remove dead plugin loader exports
target.body:
Related: #105595

## What Problem This Solves

The enforced unused-export ratchet still carried roughly 570 `src/plugins/` entries, leaving a large amount of dead internal surface and weakening the baseline as an actionable cleanup signal.

## Why This Change Was Made

Remove unused plugin-loader exports in coherent ownership groups, keeping implementations local when still used internally and deleting tests that only covered deleted code. Preserve plugin SDK barrels, manifest contracts, dynamic loader/report entry points, and other shipped surfaces; keep the few remaining test-only controls in Knip-ignored core test fixtures.

## User Impact

No user-visible behavior change. Maintainers get a substantially smaller dead-export baseline and less accidental internal API surface around plugin loading.

This PR is AI-assisted; the resulting code and contracts were reviewed and validated.

## Evidence

- Production Knip baseline: `src/plugins/` entries reduced from 574 to 7 intentional shipped/dynamic contracts; the main-synced 4,965-entry total baseline matches exactly.
- `pnpm deadcode:exports` and `pnpm check:loc` — passed at pushed head on Blacksmith Testbox `quick-lobster-0f02`.
- Focused loader, hook, memory-state, runtime-task, CLI-exit, compatibility-registry, and boundary-report tests — passed across their repo-selected Vitest shards.
- Focused plugin/auth/config suites — 365/365 passed; bundled provider-auth parity — 144/144 passed.
- `pnpm check:changed --timed` — passed all selected static, SDK surface, type, lint, policy, and cycle lanes.
- `pnpm build` — passed full core, plugin SDK, asset, and Control UI build on Blacksmith Testbox.
- Fresh structured autoreview covered the large diff in coherent chunks; one test-mock finding was fixed, and subsequent code and final-ratchet reviews were clean.
